scope: SHIPPED product stack (P5-W2): packages/product-web + apps/desktop-adcos over the real createSurfacesService; plus P5-W1 ops tooling (scripts/ops/**)

laws.noEnvVarMechanism: The shipped product reads zero environment variables at runtime; runtime configuration is constructor arguments + frozen constants only (verified by static scan; see matrix.md).
laws.bindingsNotFlags: Environments differ by BINDINGS (state path, principals, clock), never by code flags; there is no env-flag mechanism in this repo.
laws.frozenContractNamesUntouched: ADCOS_IPC_CHANNEL, ADCOS_BRIDGE_GLOBAL, ADCOS_PAYMENT_NOTICE, AdcosRequest method vocabulary, surfaces public entrypoints — documented, never renamed.

inputs.name: surfaces.statePath
inputs.allowedValues: any writable path; the durable JSONL file is created on first persist, directory created on service construction

bindings.staging: <release-gate staging workspace>/staging-state.jsonl, seeded by the restore-drill fixture

inputs.name: surfaces.now
inputs.allowedValues: any deterministic function; the domain never reads ambient time

inputs.name: surfaces.operatorPrincipals
inputs.type: readonly string[] (principals holding the operator role)
inputs.default: [] (operator views refused for everyone — fail closed)
inputs.allowedValues: principal strings; deployment configuration, NOT runtime state

bindings.production: ["ops@local"] (shipped 1.0.0 — local demo identity, honestly labeled; NOT authentication)

inputs.name: surfaces.developerPrincipals
inputs.type: readonly string[] (principals holding the developer role)
inputs.default: [] (developer views refused for everyone — fail closed)
inputs.allowedValues: principal strings; deployment configuration, NOT runtime state

inputs.name: desktop.userDataPath
inputs.consumerModule: apps/desktop-adcos/src/main/index.ts (app.getPath("userData")); Electron derives it from extraMetadata.name adcos-desktop

bindings.dev: per temp harness (battery uses its own dirs)
bindings.staging: n/a (staging runs the renderer against an explicit state file; the packaged app is not the staging vehicle)
bindings.production: Linux(ProVEN, P5-W2 smoke): ~/.config/adcos-desktop; macOS(PENDING-station): ~/Library/Application Support/ADCOS; Windows(PENDING-station): %APPDATA%\adcos-desktop

inputs.name: desktop.mainLog
inputs.allowedValues: any path; written with appendFile, created on first write

bindings.staging: adcos:request (staging replaces the transport, not the vocabulary)

inputs.name: product.localPrincipals
inputs.default: [ada@local, grace@local, ops@local, dev@local] — local demo identities, honestly labeled, NOT authenticated accounts

inputs.name: desktop.windowPolicy
inputs.default: 1280x840 (min 960x640); contextIsolation:true, nodeIntegration:false, sandbox:true; will-navigate restricted to file://; window-open denied; single-instance lock

inputs.name: ops.releaseGate.stagingPort
inputs.type: number (--staging-port <port>: local HTTP port serving the built product-web dist; default 4173)

substrateSurfaces.name: config/default.json
substrateSurfaces.consumedBy: INHERITED ZCODE SUBSTRATE settings/help tooling (packages/shared settings sources) — NOT consumed by the shipped ADCOS desktop app (product-locked; verified 0 zcode entries in the shipped asar, P5-W2)

substrateSurfaces.name: config/provider/zcode-builtin.json
substrateSurfaces.consumedBy: INHERITED ZCODE SUBSTRATE provider tooling (packages/provider-node zcode-builtin provider config source) — NOT consumed by the shipped ADCOS desktop app
substrateSurfaces.note: TEMPLATES ONLY: no literal credential values are committed; live keys are injected at substrate runtime through the declared secret channels and never touch this repo or the ADCOS product.

secrets.name: github.publishToken
secrets.protects: GitHub release publication (electron-builder publish / gh release upload) for adcos-desktop-v* releases
secrets.injectionChannel: environment variable (GH_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN), set only in the publishing shell at the integration station

secrets.name: substrate.providerApiKey
secrets.protects: INHERITED substrate provider credentials (zai-api / zai-standard-api templates; NOT used by the ADCOS product)
secrets.injectionChannel: OS keyring (substrate desktop settings) or environment variable; template files carry only the access TYPE, never the value

secrets.name: operator.adcosReleaseSigningKey
secrets.protects: IF the operator later signs release assets (not currently practiced: v1.0.0 ships SHA256SUMS only)
secrets.injectionChannel: file with permissions 0600, path supplied out-of-band; never committed

unknowns.name: liveProviderCredentials
unknowns.note: No live provider integration exists; credential shapes, rotation policy and cost are never estimated as if known.

unknowns.name: paymentRailCredentials
unknowns.status: UNKNOWN — BLOCKED-ON-OPERATOR (ADR-0004; rail selection is an operator decision)
unknowns.note: Purchases persist OPAQUE typed payment references only; no rail semantics exist anywhere in the shipped product.
